claimScope: face-preserving meshopt post-opt rung after the HB-02 albedo bake, per body; face meshes untouched, joints and body morph targets unchanged

facePreservingMode.technique: per-primitive weld, then simplifyPrimitive at the rung ratio, on every non-face mesh only; face meshes (/eye|brow|lash|teeth|tongue/i) untouched; 1-triangle gown marker untouched

errorNote: This does not repeat the FAILED TREATMENT in tools/openclinxr/evidence/eyebrow-budget/reduce-shipped-eyebrows.ts:10 (simplifyPrimitive with error=1 scattered brow strands across the body): that treatment ran unconstrained meshopt simplification directly ON the brow strand mesh, a many-tiny-component primitive where the error budget lets components drift. Here error 0.01 (one hundred times tighter) applies only to NON-face meshes — body, garments, hair, footwear — whose primitives are large connected surfaces, and face meshes are excluded by name before any simplifier call. Measured: face triangles 52778/52778 on every HB-05 body.
